title: A story the listener takes part in
description: Small actions help you follow an evening story that has a clear ending.

blocks.text: The review’s author chooses a story they take part in instead of the usual scrolling through short videos before bed. That is one specific personal scenario, not evidence that any movement or object will improve a meditation.

quote.text: I have ADHD and when I try to wind down for bed, my mind wants to watch highly engaging content like TikTok—I’m addicted to scrolling! The interaction with the bedtime stories this app offers forces me to pay attention and thus lulls me to sleep.

blocks.text: Test calm participation in a story
Offer a short story with a small number of clear actions and a predictable ending. Let people carry on with a familiar episode and judge the format before choosing a large library.

If actions, rewards and a new feed keep a person at the screen longer, the product may contradict the intention they came with. The benefit should be tested against the evening scenario they chose, without promising an effect for everyone with a similar diagnosis.
